title: 欧洲太空探索公司CEO：马斯克是灵感来源，但我们要走自己的路
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: So the transportation, transportation is what is very difficult to master, the highest barriers to entry, so very few are going to succeed, but once you have made it, you open space to, of course you are
segments.zh: 运输是最难掌握的，进入门槛最高，很少有人能成功，但一旦成功，你就能打开太空，当然也包括尽可能多的国家。

segments.en: but also as many nations as possible in our case. What does that full stack in space transportation look like? What is the cadence that you're targeting? So we've done things a little bit the other way around
segments.zh: 完整的太空运输系统是什么样的？你们的目标节奏是什么？我们有点反其道而行之。

segments.en: because we didn't start with a rocket, we started with the capsule, right?
segments.zh: 因为我们不是从火箭开始的，而是从太空舱开始的。

segments.en: One reason for that is that Europe never had its own capsule, so every time I want to fly an astronaut we need to give cash to audio friends of SpaceX and I kind of, hey we could use that money to
segments.zh: 原因之一是欧洲从未拥有自己的太空舱，每次送宇航员都得给SpaceX的朋友们送钱，我想我们可以用这笔钱在这里开发技术，同时激励人们。

segments.en: build the technology here and also to inspire people. What does sovereign and sovereign space mean to you?
segments.zh: 主权和主权太空对你意味着什么？

segments.en: So it means for us in Europe the capacity to be a leading space nation by with our own technologies. How big is the gap right now versus the US?
segments.zh: 对我们欧洲来说，这意味着有能力用自己的技术成为领先的太空国家。目前与美国的差距有多大？

segments.en: The gap is significant, especially in space transportation. We are very good in satellites but the gap is significant in space transportation, that's why we've also like you know we've been
segments.zh: 差距很大，尤其是在太空运输方面。我们在卫星方面很出色，但太空运输差距显著，所以我们一直非常专注于此。

segments.en: very focused on that because I want to have an impact where there is a gap basically and we can significantly contribute to this European sovereignty. The market is going to go towards very very
segments.zh: 我想在有差距的地方产生影响，为欧洲的主权做出贡献。市场将朝着非常非常……
